## Decision

The per-session run is collapsed: slices are sub-issues of their motive (files/folders under the motive dir, mudissue-style <label>-<slug> naming) carrying session and wave properties; the advisor gate becomes one note per session under the motive; the Stop-gate queries slices by session property plus the session gate note verdict. Pacing counts distinct waves among this session slices.

## Rationale

Eliminating the separate run ledger JSON files unifies the data model and makes slices first-class Obsidian notes. Session and wave become queryable frontmatter properties rather than ledger-file indices.
